hotspots.title: Polish Constitutional Court Crisis & Coup Accusations
hotspots.blurb: Polish President Karol Nawrocki and PiS leader Jarosław Kaczyński have escalated attacks against Prime Minister Donald Tusk, accusing his government of executing a constitutional coup and sanctioning an 'organized criminal group' within the Constitutional Tribunal. Tusk's attempts to hold private talks have been fiercely rejected by PiS leadership, converting the judicial dispute into an existential battle over state legitimacy.
hotspots.affect: The discourse is driven by intense existential alarm and outrage, depicting government action as an illegal coup to galvanize right-wing opposition.

hotspots.title: US Midterm Election Rout & MAGA Internal Backlash
hotspots.blurb: Democrats swept majorities in both houses of Congress and flipped key governorships in a devastating defeat for the Republican Party, unleashing severe internal recriminations within MAGA world. Right-wing commentators and politicians describe the outcome as a 'blue tsunami' and a direct referendum on Donald Trump's leadership, while Trump points blame at media coverage as intra-party infighting erupts.
hotspots.affect: High emotional charge generated by post-election humiliation, panicky finger-pointing, and existential dread over losing federal power.

hotspots.title: Flávio Bolsonaro Defeat & Brazil Election Fraud Claims
hotspots.blurb: Controversy intensifies surrounding Senator Flávio Bolsonaro following revelations that he left Brazil for the United States amid expanding federal money laundering investigations. Democratic US lawmakers are openly demanding his immediate deportation back to Brazil, while Bolsonarista allies organize defensive caravans and file emergency petitions to remove STF Minister Alexandre de Moraes from the case.
hotspots.affect: The narrative is fueled by intense grievance against judicial authorities and high-stakes anxiety over potential extradition and legal prosecution.

hotspots.title: Nigel Farage MP Altercation Row & Reform Campaign
hotspots.blurb: Reform UK has been hit by a major scandal after campaign manager and council leader George Madgwick was suspended and charged with 35 criminal offences, including 12 counts of rape. The revelations coincide with heightened friction surrounding Nigel Farage's stance on mass deportations and parliamentary altercations, putting party leadership on the defense ahead of local by-elections.
hotspots.affect: Coverage is saturated with severe moral charge and reputational crisis, forcing party figures into hostile damage control.

hotspots.title: Marine Le Pen Launches RN Campaign & Congress
hotspots.blurb: Rassemblement National is accelerating its 2027 presidential positioning, with polls highlighting Marine Le Pen's strong leads while Jordan Bardella promotes his new book 'Gouverner' as a blueprint for Matignon. Concurrently, intense media and legal debate continues regarding Le Pen's court eligibility and sharp pushback from rival conservative leaders like Bruno Retailleau.
hotspots.affect: The story generates momentum through triumphant electoral self-assertion contrasted against fierce partisan conflict with mainstream right rivals.
